phoneShifts.title: Phone shifts
phoneShifts.unavailable: Phone shifts could not be checked. Check the connection and try again.

phoneShifts.openDescription: {{count}} phone shift(s) still open. The day cannot close until each one is closed.
phoneShifts.closeAction: Close it on the phone, or from Staff on this register
phoneShifts.pendingReturnsDescription: Closed phone tills whose cash this register has not received yet. Receive it here; until then it stays listed, also the next day.
phoneShifts.refusedOpen: The day was not closed: phone shifts are still open: {{shifts}}. Close each one on the phone, or from Staff on this register.
phoneShifts.refusedOpenUnnamed: The day was not closed: a phone shift is still open. Close it on the phone, or from Staff on this register.
phoneShifts.refusedUnavailable: The day was not closed: the phone shifts could not be checked. Check the connection and try again.

phoneShifts.openBlocker: Close the phone shifts before closing this shift: {{shifts}}. Close them on the phone, or here in staff selection.
phoneShifts.receiveBlocker: Receive the cash from these phone tills in staff selection before closing this shift: {{tills}}.
phoneShifts.managerSettles: This till can't be received here. A manager settles it.
phoneShifts.openHelper: Still open on a phone. Each one holds the Z until it is closed.
phoneShifts.lastChecked: No connection. Phone shifts as last checked at {{time}}.
phoneShifts.lastCheckedBlocker: No connection. As last checked at {{time}}: {{reasons}}
phoneShifts.lastSeenStale: This phone was last online at {{time}}. Orders or payments it has not sent are not in these figures.
phoneShifts.lastSeenUnknown: This phone's last connection is unknown. Orders or payments it has not sent may be missing from these figures.

closeWithoutHandover.explain: The shift closes without cash: nothing is added to this drawer. A manager settles its money.
closeWithoutHandover.closed: {{name}}'s shift is closed without a handover. Nothing was added to this drawer.
closeWithoutHandover.closedNotCounted: {{name}}'s shift is closed without a handover and its cash is marked not counted. Nothing was added to this drawer; a manager settles its money.
closeWithoutHandover.alreadyClosed: {{name}}'s shift was already closed. Nothing was added to this drawer.

errors.reasonRequired: Enter a reason, up to 500 characters.
errors.pinRequired: A manager enters their own PIN.
errors.wrongPin: That PIN can't approve it. A manager with the right to cancel orders enters their own PIN.
errors.notStaff: That PIN belongs to no active staff member of this business, so it can't approve it.
errors.mainOnly: Only the main till of this phone's register can close its shifts.
errors.offline: No connection. The shift closes only online: check the connection and try again.
errors.failed: The shift couldn't be closed. Nothing changed; try again.
errors.approvalRequired: This manager can't approve closing a shift without a handover.

phoneShifts.needsCashier: Received here once a cashier is checked in.

phoneShift.closedByMain: {{name}}'s shift on {{phone}} was closed at the register

messages.phoneShiftRemoteCheckoutRequired: This shift is on a phone. Close it on the phone, or from Staff on this register, where its cash is counted.

zReportHeldForPhoneShifts.title: Z waiting for phone shifts
zReportHeldForPhoneShifts.summary: The server holds this Z until these phone shifts close: {{shifts}}.
zReportHeldForPhoneShifts.summaryUnnamed: The server holds this Z until the open phone shifts close.
zReportHeldForPhoneShifts.guidance: Close them on the phone, or from Staff on this register. The Z is sent by itself afterwards; nothing is lost.

blockerReasons.zReportUnitShiftsOpen: The Z waits: phone shifts are still open: {{shifts}}. Close them on the phone, or from Staff on this register; the Z is sent by itself afterwards.
blockerReasons.zReportUnitShiftsOpenUnnamed: The Z waits: a phone shift is still open. Close it on the phone, or from Staff on this register; the Z is sent by itself afterwards.
